To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the proposed algorithm is a novel class of methods that offer improved accuracy over existing methods, and (b) the proposed algorithm can be used in both continuous and discrete domains, with the former domain being a more challenging setting.

(i) we introduce the estimated mixture policy ( EMP ) algorithm for infinite-horizon off-policy policy evaluation, (ii) we show that EMP can estimate the state stationary distribution with lower variance and state-action stationary distribution with useful induction bias, (iii) we show that our algorithm is significantly more accurate than state-of-the-art algorithms in extensive experiments with both discrete and continuous environments

1) We consider off-policy evaluation with multiple behavior policies, which is a common scenario in real-world applications; 2) We propose estimated mixture policies (EMP), a new class of policy-agnostic methods that are able to estimate state and state-action stationary distribution; and 3) We show that EMP is able to achieve improved accuracy compared to state-of-the-art off-policy evaluation methods.

the problem of estimating the stationary distributions of a mixture policy, and we propose a new algorithm that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.
